name: Disneyland Milk Stand "Green Milk" (Tropical Blossom & Citrus Warning)
whyItWorks: Unlike Blue Milk, Green Milk has pronounced tropical citrus and floral notes with citric acid additives that can irritate sensitive stomachs and acid reflux.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: choose the gentle, non-citrus Blue Milk instead.
watchOuts: Contains citrus flavor extracts that can cause heartburn
